listing.name: Quake (Ironwail)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native Quake implementation with desktop packages. Limits: Distinct alternative to vkQuake, not another game; preserve per-implementation identity. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux native desktop packages/source builds, exact selected CPUs unknown in frozen evidence. macOS explicitly unsupported due to OpenGL4.3 requirements. Original data: Use original Quake game data. Retained Ironwail README supports the 2021 rerelease and installed Steam Quake/add-ons through automatic discovery when no valid local Quake installation is present. Exact required classic/release PAK set and accepted data revision are not established by that README; mods/add-ons are separate data. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
